title: Addressing the QC reviewer
description: How to write for a reader acting as QC reviewer. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `qc-reviewer` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Concrete and artefact-anchored
rules.description: Concrete and artefact-anchored. Name the page, the build, the URL. A claim about source is not evidence about output.

source.quote: Checks the BUILT artefact, not the source. Looks at the rendered page, the PDF, the published site — and cares whether it is correct there, not whether the manifest was valid.
